explication: Tulip is a portable, programmable creative computer and AMYboard platform built around MicroPython, LVGL, and AMY. A user enters or runs Python through a platform-specific boot target; MicroPython executes it, then routes graphics/UI, audio, storage, networking, and hardware I/O to the selected runtime. LVGL manages widgets, rendering, and input dispatch, while platform drivers reach displays and touch devices. The tree confirms platform entrypoints and representative LVGL/driver implementations; several documented application subsystems are represented only by their enclosing product directories.
